ASPIRE.notes: ASPIRE (MTN-020, dapivirine ring) is one of the two dapivirine ring RCTs pooled in this meta-analysis of perinatal outcomes. Layer (b) TRUE: characteristics table places trial sites in eastern and southern Africa (Malawi, South Africa, Uganda, Zimbabwe). Layer (c) TRUE: 'all eligible studies recruited from just six countries in eastern and southern Africa' is a direct narrative statement placing all included trials, including ASPIRE, in Africa.
